findings.title: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer for Magento 2 — CVE-2026-45247 (CVSS 9.8) Unauthenticated PHP-Object-Deserialization RCE Promoted from Noted → CISA KEV (2026-06-03) + Active Imperva Exploitation Observed
findings.affected_technology: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer extension for Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce versions < 1.11.12; processes attacker-controlled CacheWarmer cookie on ordinary storefront requests and passes it to PHP unserialize() without class allow-listing (CWE-502); exploit primitive is a single cookie value on any normal storefront request, no auth required
findings.summary: Mirasvit Magento Cache Warmer (Watchtower 2026-06-06 NOTED, no CVE then) now has CVE-2026-45247 (CVSS 9.8), is on CISA KEV as of 2026-06-03 (Watchtower missed), and Imperva confirms in-the-wild exploitation with the CacheWarmer:(Tz|Qz|YT) cookie IOC — patch to 1.11.12 immediately on all Magento / Adobe Commerce storefronts.

findings.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot CVE-2026-45497 — First Publicly-Acknowledged Critical RCE in a Major-Cloud Enterprise AI Assistant via Command Injection With Service-Container Scope Change, Already Mitigated Server-Side
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft 365 Copilot cloud service; command-injection primitive (CWE-77) allowing authorized attacker to execute code over network with scope change (S:C) indicating break-out from Copilot service container into other M365 components; no customer-side artifact, fix shipped server-side; companion advisory CVE-2026-42824 covers an info-disclosure path in the same service
findings.summary: Microsoft published CVE-2026-45497 on 2026-06-04 — a critical command-injection RCE in M365 Copilot whose scope change allowed container break-out into other M365 components; already mitigated in Microsoft cloud with no customer action and no in-wild observation, but a notable precedent as the first publicly-acknowledged critical RCE in a major-cloud enterprise AI assistant.

noted.product: CISA KEV adds Linux cgroup auth bypass + Android Framework integer overflow (2026-06-02)
noted.summary: Linux cgroup-1 release_agent privilege bypass historically used in container-escape chains, relevant to shared-tenant container infra running cgroup-v1; Android integer overflow mobile-only OOS. Both long-patched upstream.
Companion advisory to CVE-2026-45497 RCE above; already mitigated server-side with no customer action; tracked as additional AI-platform calibration data point.
